intents.title: UiSuccess screen closes; its text is localizable
intents.reason: Maid has no sidebar success screen with a close handler that can be dropped: the save result is a lasting toast with a close button, and the changeset links and texts are set in SaveButton, with Paraglide texts. The bug (close X emitting an event after the mode exited) cannot occur in a React toast.

intents.title: Zoom easing no longer flies off (GraphicsSystem._tform)
intents.reason: The fix is in Rapid's PixiJS GraphicsSystem tween, which Maid does not have: map zoom and easing are MapLibre's easeTo (grep for flyTo, jumpTo, easeTo, _tform, transformEase found only camera.ts and module-notes). MapLibre interpolates zoom itself, so the log-scale drift cannot happen in Maid.

intents.title: utilKeybinding replaced by KeyboardSystem
intents.reason: Maid's editor keys are one React hook on @tanstack/react-hotkeys (useShortcuts.ts), not utilKeybinding, so the KeyboardSystem class, scopes and rebind API have no counterpart; Rapid's UiRapidInspector A/D/M/R scope exists only in Rapid. Text fields keep their own keys (isTyping in MapView.tsx), and Maid already turns editor keys off behind a dialog (commit 42f286c). Not checked: whether tanstack matches on event.key or event.code.

intents.title: DatabaseSystem wraps IndexedDB: multi-session restore, in-use heartbeat, files stored as Blobs, storage stats (counters reverted, canStoreAsync added)
intents.reason: Multi-session restore is a deliberate difference: docs/architecture/09-storage-and-settings.md section 1 says one tab owns the unsaved edits and that, unlike Rapid, an old journal is migrated rather than refused; Maid keeps one journal per data source (shell journal.ts:54-58), and a second tab is refused by the Web Lock (journal.ts:194-210). The in-use flag is already-have as the Web Lock, released by the browser when the tab closes (journal.ts:464). Files as Blobs is not-relevant: Maid keeps no files (Panel.tsx:297 'a file is kept only until the page is reloaded'). Storage counters and canStoreAsync are already-have as the standing notice when storage fails (RestorePrompt.tsx:41-49, shell journal.ts:62). If Tobias wants a session list, that is a new needs-decision, against the doc.

intents.title: Custom Rapid datasets from a picked or dropped file: file picker and drag-and-drop via DragAndDropSystem, file kept in DatabaseSystem, dataset named from the file
intents.reason: Dropping a GeoJSON/GPX file on the map: Maid will build its own, an optimisation for later. Step in docs/build-out/steps.md (Upstream sync). Rapid's IndexedDB file storage is not wanted (files live until reload).

intents.title: Default imagery selection improved
intents.reason: Maid picks the best background only when it covers more than half of the view (coverage.ts:71 coversMoreThanHalf, used by eli.ts:36-50 bestBackgrounds), so a layer that covers only a corner of the view, as San Juan, is not picked; overlays are skipped (eli.ts:43). The stored choice must be valid for the view (start.ts:56) and the order is best, stored, default, first, which matches the upstream order.

intents.title: OSM entities marked seen only once results are delivered; seenIDs and skipSeen removed (PR #4 fixes cancelled loads)
intents.reason: Maid never marks an entity or tile as seen before its data arrives: a tile becomes loaded only when its answer is parsed, in the same synchronous step as the merge (tile-loader.ts:138-143), and a cancelled or superseded request goes back to idle and merges nothing (tile-loading.ts:125, 181-183, settleLoad rejects a request that is not current). The merge skips entities already in the graph (data.ts:64-67), so there is no seen-set to lose on abort. Leftover: the seenIDs parameter of EditHistory.merge (EditHistory.ts:559, 585-586) is unused by callers, harmless.
